name: Modifies Initiative
description: Improves the user's own initiative rolls.

mechanics.text: While active, the user rolls initiative with advantage, or with a flat bonus, depending on tier. Same tier ladder as feat.skill-bonus, reused rather than reinvented — initiative is its own roll type, not a skill check, so it's kept as its own Feature rather than folded into that one, but the underlying magnitude ladder (advantage/+2/+5/+10) is identical.
